body:
## Purpose

This PR fixes the recompilation of GPU slice loops whose operator buffers exceed their level of shared memory on Julia 1.12 and later, which came up when CliMA/ClimaAtmos.jl#4953 moved to Julia 1.13.

## Disclosure

This PR and its description were mostly generated using Claude.

## Content

 - `shmem_level_error_bytes` reads the bytes that a slice loop needs from markers named by a `SubString{String}` as well as a `String`, so that the loop is compiled again at the next level of shared memory on Julia 1.12 and later.
 - Those versions emit calls to undefined functions through lazily initialized PLT entries, which GPUCompiler names by a `SubString` of the entry's name, so every such loop threw the `InvalidIRError` of its first compilation. This was observed in [13 GPU jobs of a ClimaAtmos build on Julia 1.13](https://buildkite.com/clima/climaatmos-ci/builds/32512), from a `foreach_slab` with a `LumpedRestriction` of a temporary.
 - A new test checks the bytes read from the compile error of a kernel that calls a marker, and from errors in the forms of Julia 1.11 and 1.12+.

body:
I asked a LLM to look into how latency can be improved and it suggested these following changes:

- specialize on `CuFunction` instead of `HostKernel`,
- broadcast argument one by one,
- use _broadcast_getindex for point slices,
- and optimizations with inferred slice size.

This branch and the `kp/latency` branch on UnrolledUtilities (see https://github.com/CliMA/UnrolledUtilities.jl/pull/41) gave a -9.2% decrease in latency. See https://buildkite.com/clima/climacoupler-time-to-first-step/builds/63#01a1cd39-0885-49c2-ba1e-6be28b8239ba.
title: Latency fixes
